sections.title: Every customer is *important*
body: The Ivy Cottage proudly serves the Aiken area. We are family owned and operated, and we are committed to offering only the finest floral arrangements and gifts, backed by service that is friendly and prompt.
Because all of our customers are important, our professional staff is dedicated to making your experience a pleasant one. That is why we always go the extra mile to make your floral gift perfect.

sections.title: Sending flowers?
sections.text: Call the shop and tell us what you have in mind.

before: The web address the shop’s directory listings still give, theivycottageflowersandgifts.com, shows only an error: “Page cannot be displayed. Please contact your service provider.”
Customers who follow those listings hit that error instead of a phone number; the shop’s newer site is at a different address they would have to find on their own
The words on this concept come from the shop’s public Visit Aiken listing
after: A working page, today: name, phone, address and map
One-tap call and directions on a phone
Served over HTTPS with nothing to break or renew
Room to grow: arrangements, occasions and photos can be added as the shop supplies them
